name: smart-compact
description: Compacts between turns when the context is full enough, sooner after a commit, PR, approved plan or finished todo list, or when the prompt cache is about to go cold or the 5-hour limit runs low.

threshold.title: Compact at
threshold.description: Context fill that compacts on its own, as soon as a turn ends.

floor.title: Never below
floor.description: Context fill under which nothing lowers the threshold far enough to compact.

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: How long the API keeps the cache after its last use. Auto takes 1h on a subscription and 5m on an API key or cloud provider; pick 5m while a subscription draws on usage credits.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.description: Compact sooner after a commit, a PR opened or merged, an approved plan, a finished todo list or a branch switch, with a summary shaped for it.

continue.title: Continue after
continue.description: Send a prompt to carry on after compacting while todos or tasks are still open, unless the turn was interrupted or ended on a question.
